title: feat(invoices): delete a draft invoice
description: Users can now delete an invoice while it is still a draft. Adds `DELETE /invoices/:id`: 204 when the draft is deleted, 404 when the invoice does not exist or is no longer a draft.
rationale: The sibling routes call `requirePermission` (`invoices:read`, `invoices:write`); the new delete route does not, so a read-only member can delete drafts.

extras.note: the planned defect, anchored elsewhere: the missing permission check seen from the tests: no reader-gets-403 test on DELETE, unlike PATCH
tenant isolation of the new delete rests on the accountId filter and no test covers it
a single-document fixture cannot tell deleteOne from a filter that deletes too much
the 404 for a missing invoice, promised by the description, is not tested
the guard is an equality on 'draft': one non-draft status proves it, a 'sent' case adds nothing
404 for a non-draft is what the description promises and what PATCH does; the finding admits it is consistent
